{"CommandLine":"for pid in /proc/[0-9]*; do
  if [ -d "$pid/fd" ]; then
    for fd in "$pid/fd/"*; do
      target=$(readlink "$fd" 2>/dev/null)
      if echo "$target" | grep -q "socket:"; then
        # check socket inode
        inode=$(echo "$target" | sed 's/socket:\[\([0-9]*\)\]/\1/')
        if grep -q " 8090 " /proc/net/tcp 2>/dev/null || grep -q " 1F9A " /proc/net/tcp 2>/dev/null; then
          # 8090 in hex is 1F9A
          if grep -q "$inode" /proc/net/tcp 2>/dev/null; then
            cat "$pid/cmdline" | tr '\0' ' '
            echo " PID: $(basename $pid)"
            break 2
          fi
        fi
      fi
    done
  fi
done","Cwd":"/home/azureuser","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Finding process for port 8090 via proc","toolSummary":"Find 8090 PID via proc"}
